verdict.rationale: Workable lists a 'Custom report builder' on its pricing page, but only as a single feature label. Data can be pulled out through its documented REST API, which offers read endpoints for jobs, candidates, events, stages and requisitions and is pitched as giving 'full control over your data'. That is a general data API, not a dedicated reporting or warehouse pipeline. Missing for 10: scheduled exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a reporting-specific API or report-export endpoint, any detail on what the report builder can do, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
